pipeline: two-stage curriculum: stage1 easy (2.5M) then stage2 full (5M, load stage1 best)

stage1.note: timesteps raised 2M->2.5M to satisfy iron rule 4 (updates>=300); paper cmd gives only 244

stage2.cmd: uv run python train_ppo.py train --timesteps 5000000 --n-envs 32 --seed 0 --load ckpt/best_model.zip

eval_cmd_nominal: uv run python train_ppo.py eval --model ckpt/best_model.zip -v --out results/.../fig_follow_eval_nominal.png
eval_cmd_dr: uv run python train_ppo.py eval --model ckpt/best_model.zip --domain-randomize -v --out results/.../fig_follow_eval_dr.png
acceptance: RL mean|e| <= 1.3cm and zero collisions; rule P crashes 10/10; rule P+FF ~2cm
